sheet.name: Bog Witch
sheet.footprint: 2x2; two cells behind = Rear + Blindspot (R/eye); Weakspot (W) = the cell left and the cell right of the front row

traits.name: One with the Bog
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Place a Bog Witch Encounter Monster token on the leftmost space of the Bog track.
Bog Move: When Bog Witch performs a Bog Move, she performs an action corresponding to the token’s location on the track. Then, move the token clockwise to the next space.
Target: The Target of Bog Move is always the Target of the Attack (in case of multiple Targets, the first that is being resolved) or the Attacker.

Swamp: Place a 2x2 Swamp Terrain tile under the Bog Witch, then place the Bog Witch fully on the Swamp Terrain tile furthest from the Target.
Mud Wisp: Place the Mud Wisp marker on W space. Then the Bog Witch moves 4 spaces directly away from the Target without turning.
Rotten Stump: Place a Rotten Stump Terrain tile under the Bog Witch, then remove her from the Clash Board. The Bog Witch still performs Attacks when outside the Clash Board.

traits.name: Hex Weaver
traits.text:
After resolving the AI card that targeted you, place it on your Knight Board. As long as you have an AI card on your Knight Board, you are Hexed—refer to the Hex effect on the AI. You can only have one Hex at a time. If you would gain a Hex while already Hexed, return the same or lower Level Hex AI to the AI discard pile. When you die, return your Hex AI to the AI discard pile.

Party Hex: Some Hexes take effect on all Knights. If an AI with a Party Hex hits at least one Knight, place it on the Bog Witch Sheet after you resolve it. It takes effect until the end of the Clash. There can be only one Party Hex on the Bog Witch Sheet, if you would place another one, return the first Hex to the AI discard pile.

traits.name: Talisman Hunt
traits.text:
When you attack from a Weakspot W space, before drawing a BP card you may take any other BP card from the deck and, without revealing its face side, place it on top of the BP deck.

You may not choose a card from the discard pile, and you must keep all other cards in their existing order in the deck.

traits.name: Wispers of the Bog
traits.text:
Zone 2 around the Mud Wisp marker is the Wisper Zone. If you’re in the Wisper Zone, you cannot voluntarily move outside the Zone. If you move onto a Mud Wisp marker, immediately stop the movement, [React] place the Bog Witch on the Mud Wisp occupying the most Knight spaces and facing the most Knights, then discard the marker.

Stray X: Move X spaces directly to the Mud Wisp marker moving around any occupied spaces. If there is no Mud Wisp on the Clash Board, move to the closest Terrain tile instead. Treat this as voluntary movement.

traits.name: Misfortune’s Mistress
traits.text: You can have multiple Hexes on you. The Bog Witch can have multiple Party Hexes on her Sheet. Do not return Hex cards to the AI discard pile when gaining a new Hex or when a Hexed Knight dies. If there are no AI cards in the AI deck, all Knights die. You lose the Clash!

traits.name: Cookie Crumbs
traits.text:
Each time the Bog Witch gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a Generic token on this Trait. Depending on the number of Generic tokens on this Trait at the end of the Monster Round the Bog Witch:
3–5: Performs Signature.
6–8: Performs an AI instead.
9+: Performs Signature, then performs an AI.

traits.name: The Crone of the Bog
traits.text: End of Monster Round: If the Bog Witch is not on the Clash Board, a random Knight gains the Hex of the top AI card as if it was just performed against them.
